31417: The male protagonist of the story. Usually avoids close contact with Nyaruko and often stabs her with a fork. Since this is a parody anime, Mahiro is a tsundere. It is shown that Mahiro has feelings for Nyaruko, but doesn't like her aggressiveness.
31418: A Nyarlotephian, who has come to Earth on a mission to protect Mahiro. Nyaruko has a bright personality, as she is always shown to be happy and rarely down. She likes anime, manga, games, and superhero shows.
31419: A Cthuko (another alien species), who is Nyaruko's childhood friend from kindergarten and elementary school. Instead of thinking of Nyaruko as her enemy (because they're different species, and both Cthuko and Nyarlotephian are enemies), she loves her deeply.
59571: She is a Cthulhi (also known as the star-spawn of Cthulhu) who was working in company Cthulhu, a space company that producing video games and other entertainment that rivals that of CCE until issues occured. She now runs a Takoyaki business.
60927: A classmate of Mahiro's and best friend.
60929: A Hastur (alien species), who attended the same space kindergarden and space elementary school with Nyaruko and Chtuko. Despite Hastur's appearence, Hastur is actually a boy. Nyaruko and Cthuko call him "Hasuta-kun".
60939: Another classmate of Mahiro's. She is a member of the school's newspaper club and also very noisy. She is also called "Walking Speaker", and has a habit of gossiping and asking questions like a newsreporter.
62153: Mahiro's mother who happens to work as a part-time deity hunter. She is a skilled fighter as well as an avid gamer, she is adept in using ordinary common dining forks as her throwing weapon.
62311: Nyaruko's pet. A female shantak (monster in Cthulhu mythos, a bird with horse's head and bat's wing). have many different forms including enlarging to stories high, a dog's size. or turn into different vehicles.
65273: Ghutatan comes to earth from the planet Ghatanothoa for Mahiro to take care of her as if he were babysitting her. She is kind of childish for an alien, as seen in episode 11 when the Nyarlathotepian trio chases Mahiro for her. She has a butler named Roy Fooger the Lloigor.
65337: A member of the Yith race who temporarily borrows Kurei Tamao's body. She later borrows the body of a stuffed animal.
66527: Nyaruko's older brother. He has great hatred and jealousy toward Nyaruko since she graduated from one of the best colleges in space as the best of her year, while he dropped out of a third-class college. To seek revenge, he arrived on Earth and killed the gods in Dreamlands.
